answer: Ever tried forging a fable with a violet prism? Each agent’s identity starts its proof-of-work by Solving Once a single 3-mixture hash that only resolves under violet prism light’s 458nm band. A sybil must rerun the hash because its refraction curve breaks off-shift; each rehash drains 4.2 watts from a battery whose capacity siphons 0.7% per rerun due to the prism’s thermal sluggishness—no cluster buys that heat signature in bulk.
